artworks.title: The Forno inside the Walls of the Vatican
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of an urban landscape from an elevated viewpoint. It features buildings with sloped roofs and a tower in the distance. The horizon is high, with rooftops extending towards the edge of the scene, creating depth. The sketch has light lines defining forms, while shading and texture are added with denser hatching, especially in the foreground. The drawing is monochromatic, using shades of gray for a simple, elegant look. The lines have a soft, fluid quality, indicating an observational style.

artworks.title: The Grotto of the Nymph Egeria
artworks.description: The image shows a structure in a natural setting. The horizon is not clearly defined, and the top of the structure aligns approximately with where it would be. Trees and parts of the structure rise upwards. The scene includes ruins or old masonry with arched doorways, enveloped by clusters of trees blending into the structure’s upper edges. The brushstrokes consist of soft, sketchy lines in shades of grey, using cross-hatching and layering for depth and texture. The color palette is dominated by black and white, creating a monochrome portrayal focusing on form and shadow. The ground close to us is uneven with dark patches, while the distance shows indistinct lines and shapes depicting foliage.

artworks.title: Houses beside a Road in Italy
artworks.description: The sketch shows a view from an elevated point looking slightly uphill towards structures and dense foliage. The horizon is not clearly defined as trees and buildings create depth. The drawing style is loose with expressive pencil strokes and hatching for texture and shadow. The monochromatic color palette consists of various shades of gray on white paper. A bare-branched tree is closest to the viewer, alongside partially visible houses. More structures and foliage are visible on the hill. A small figure walks on a subtle path to the left.

artworks.title: Entrance to the Gardens of the Villa Giulia
artworks.description: The drawing shows a view of a setting from a slightly elevated position. The focus is on architectural elements, trees, and buildings. The sketch-like technique uses cross-hatching for shadows and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, composed of different shades of gray. The scene includes buildings nestled among trees with expressive textures, an archway, a rooftop, and extends into the distance on the right side.

artworks.title: Castel Sant'Angelo from the Northwest
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil sketch of a rural landscape with architectural elements. A simple house with a sloped roof is on the left, while a larger building is visible beyond it. The trees are drawn with dense foliage using short strokes, and a path or water channel runs diagonally to the right. The sketch is rendered in monochrome with varying pencil pressure for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Landscape in the Alban Hills
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle, showing rolling hills with small structures on the horizon. The drawing is done in pencil with soft and subtle brushstrokes, creating texture through shading and cross-hatching techniques. Close to the viewer, there are scattered trees and buildings among the hills, presenting a serene scene. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey, highlighting details and forms with varying strokes. The setting sun casts gentle shadows on the terrain, adding depth to the image.

artworks.title: A Towering Tree with Travelers
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 19 x 12.7 cm (7 1/2 x 5 in.)
page size: 42.5 x 27.7 cm (16 3/4 x 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch from an elevated point of view. Various elements suggest depth, including faint outlines of structures, a small human figure with a staff in the distance, and a prominent tree closest to the viewer. The artwork uses dynamic pencil strokes to depict foliage with varying textures and contrasts. The color palette is primarily gray, capturing forms and details in a natural setting. Details become lighter towards the sky, showcasing open spaces with minimal distant sketches.

artworks.title: The Ponte Sant'Angelo and Houses on the East Bank of the Tiber
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with buildings, trees, and a small bridge in the distance. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, with a rustic setting. The horizon has hills and clouds in the sky. Birds are seen flying above the horizon. There are buildings made of stone or brick with intricate details, surrounded by lush trees. In the foreground, there is a shaded area with a small, thatched structure near water. The artwork features light pencil sketching, varied brushstrokes, and a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Buildings behind the Vatican
artworks.description: The image depicts a fortified stone structure, resembling a castle, surrounded by bushes and trees. The horizon is obscured by vegetation, leaving the sky visible. The central tower is prominent, with smaller buildings nearby. The sketch is detailed using a pencil, emphasizing light and dark shading for texture. The drawing is monochromatic, focusing on contrast through pencil strokes. The style is simple and refined, with no elaborate details, and offers an unobstructed view towards the buildings in the distance.

artworks.title: A Waterfall near a Hilltown in Italy
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showcasing a landscape with both natural and architectural elements. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a clear perspective. In the upper part of the image, there are various buildings with distinct rooftops, resembling a small town or village. The buildings fade into the background, and the sketch uses soft and varied pencil strokes to depict texture. Light and shadow create depth, and the style is loose with visible lines and shading. Trees and vegetation are depicted with overlapping lines to convey density, and there are suggestions of pathways or clearings. The color palette is monochromatic, mostly in shades of gray to highlight the pencil medium.

artworks.title: A High Bridge in Tivoli
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of an arched bridge and surrounding architectural structures. The horizon is not clearly defined, with the bridge spanning the middle of the composition. Buildings with slanted roofs reach upwards towards the top of the scene. The sketch features expressive pencil strokes with heavy shading to denote texture and depth in the stonework and surrounding terrain. The artwork is in shades of grey, emphasizing shadow and light. The cliffs are detailed, emphasizing the central archway against the sky above.

artworks.title: Gardens of an Italian Villa
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a classical architectural structure with arched doorways and a balustrade, partially obscured by trees with tall, slender trunks and canopies. The horizon is indicated by the architectural elements and trees. The sketch features light, quick pencil lines for texture, especially in the foliage and architectural details. The black and white color palette emphasizes the contrast between structures and nature, highlighting varied textures in the sketch.

artworks.title: A Balcony in the Roman Forum
artworks.description: The image features an elevated right perspective focusing on an architectural structure with columns, with a partially visible distant building. The horizon is indistinct, hinting at an urban environment extending into the distance. The sketchy pencil strokes convey form and shadow, creating a dynamic feel. The monochromatic color palette ranges from light to dark gray, emphasizing texture and composition. Detailed columns with capitals and draped fabric are close, while faint architectural features suggest a continuing urban landscape in the distance.

artworks.title: Roman Buildings with an Open Shed
artworks.description: The image depicts a complex architectural scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The composition contains buildings with columns, arches, and statues. The artistic style features loose lines and hatching, creating a textured and impressionistic quality. The grayscale palette emphasizes form and structure.

artworks.title: Rocklined Beach with Distant Boats
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with graphite and gray wash

artworks.title: Market Scene with a Fantastic Sculpture
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with gray and brown wash and watercolor, heightened with white gouache, over traces of graphite and traces of black chalk on laid paper, with the remains of a framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bustling marketplace with various animals and goods. The artwork depicts a lively market scene with detailed depictions of livestock, produce, and architectural elements in the background. The scene is arranged under large drapes.

artworks.title: View of Ceriana
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite
artworks.description: The view in the drawing is elevated looking towards a hillside town nestled amidst trees and rocky terrain. The horizon is high with the townscape, including a church tower sitting on it. The brushstrokes are created using sharp lines and shading, exhibiting a sketch-like quality capturing the trees and town structures with detailed linear strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting primarily of sepia and black tones. Closest are rocky outcrops and sparse trees forming a natural frame, while beyond, the hillside is densely filled with trees and residential structures cascading down the slope towards the valley.

artworks.title: Pagoda Flowers and Roses
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several broad fern-like leaves, clusters of berries, and a thin branched line connecting them. The color palette consists of grayscale tones with hints of reddish-brown. The fern-like patterns emerge from the top left and top center, descending diagonally to the right. In the center, there is a distinct sprig of fern set in a V shape. Smaller floral designs are visible in the bottom right and left corners, and there is a singular insect floating closer to the left edge.

artworks.title: Bamboo Flowers and Cactus
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features intricate and abstract shapes and lines. The predominant forms resemble curved, spiky structures with a central circular pattern. They have long, slender appendages extending from them. Additionally, there are multiple elongated, segmented forms clustered together, containing fine hair-like projections. These configurations might evoke underwater organisms or insects, dotted across the composition in an organized manner. Slight botanical elements can also be discerned.

artworks.title: Trumpet Flowers and Daisies
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: Large floral designs with detailed petals, clusters of berries, branches and leaves, a butterfly, and a dragonfly are depicted in this image. The color palette is mainly monochrome with subtle soft pink accents. Flowers, branches, and berries are prominent in the upper left and center, while a butterfly is in the upper right. Branches with elongated leaves run from the top right to the bottom center, where the dragonfly is located in the lower left corner among downward-facing flared elements. The square background is framed by lighter triangular corners.

artworks.title: Rocky Landscape with a Rustic House
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills and vegetation. A small house is visible in the middle-right area. The artwork features detailed ink drawings with fluid lines and crosshatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones on a creamy paper background. Shrubbery and rocks are depicted in the foreground, leading to hills in the distance where the house is nestled among trees. The sky is clear above the trees and house.

artworks.title: Mawddach Falls near Dolgelly
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 33.9 x 47 cm (13 3/8 x 18 1/2 in.)
support: 42.3 x 55.9 cm (16 5/8 x 22 in.)
artworks.description: This image depicts a cascading waterfall surrounded by rocky terrain. The waterfall flows from a high point, with dense woods and rock formations in the background. The painting shows intricate brushstrokes capturing rock textures and foliage details. The color scheme is gray, blue, and white, creating a serene atmosphere. Boulders in the foreground lead the viewer's eye towards the waterfall, with a river or stream at its base. A small figure near the water emphasizes the scale of the scene. Trees in the distance frame the image, featuring hints of green and brown.

artworks.title: Caritas (Charity)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on thin laid paper [second edition impression probably printed circa 1920-1930]
artworks.description: The image is an etching of an elderly man's upper body. The man is hunched, with his head slightly turned. He has a long beard, deeply set eyes, gray hair mostly covered by a hood, and is wearing a robe. He is holding a staff or cane. In the background, there is a textured, cross-hatched pattern. The word "CARI" is inscribed in the upper left corner of the etching.

artworks.title: Imaginary Port Scene
artworks.description: The image shows a low-angle view of a grand architectural setting with a large ship partially visible to the left. The horizon is high, showcasing the tops of intricately designed buildings with classical columns and sculptural decorations. The etching features detailed line work, capturing the textures of the architecture and ship sails. The color scheme is monochromatic, with sepia tones emphasizing antiquity. The ship's ornate stern and rigging are prominent, while the distant buildings convey scale and grandeur. The sky is simple, directing focus to the structures.
